messages:
Sam: Quick sync — we have a candidate (Emma Li) for Sr ML Eng. Recruiter put a 90min window on Thu 10:00–11:30 PT. Need panel: system design, infra/serving, coding, and product/behavioral. Who can take which slot? Also need a lead interviewer to own debrief.
Maya K: I can do system design. Prefer 10:00–10:45 slice. happy to be lead if no one else volunteers. :thumbsup:
Jordan: I can do infra/serving (10:45–11:15). Quick Q on the rubric: are we still using the new 1-5 scale where 3 = meets expectations? want to make sure my notes align.
Alia: I can cover product/behavioral but only 11:00–11:30 PT, overlap with Jordan a bit — fine to shorten Jordan to 25m. Also timezone note: Emma is in EST. Recruiter confirmed they'll be okay with 10am PT.
Nate (recruiter_bot): Candidate profile + calendar invite posted: https://cal.example/meet/emmali. Interview packet attached. We blocked 10:00–11:30 PT and added buffer. Emma's resume + takehome link: https://files.example/emmali_resume.pdf
Sam: thanks. Jordan — yes, rubric v2 is active. 1 = needs coaching, 3 = solid, 5 = exceptional. Please use the short anchors in the doc (technical depth, system tradeoffs, latency/cost reasoning, collaboration). Link: https://docs.example/rubrics/ml-eng-rubric-v2
Jordan: got it. can you confirm how to score coding if partial solution but solid tests? is that a 3 or 4?
Maya K: For coding: completeness + correctness = baseline. If they demonstrate good tests and clear thought but miss an edge case, lean 3. If they show strong optimizations or algorithmic improvements, 4.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder — debriefs required within 24h of interview. Use /debrief form or the Google sheet. Late debriefs will delay hiring decisions.
Alia: Small ask — can we do a 5min pre-read hangout 5min before each panelist joins? I can share a one-pager with key signals we want to capture.
Sam: yes please. Alia can host the pre-read. I'll create a short agenda and paste in the event notes.
Nate (recruiter_bot): Emily (scheduling) updated invite with pre-read link and set a 5min buffer. Candidate confirmed.
Jordan: one more rubric clarification — behavioral/culture: do we include leadership metrics for IC4+? where is that field in the form?
Sam: good call — there's an "impact & leadership" checkbox in section B of the form. It's optional for IC3, recommended for IC4+. I'll ping people-ops to highlight it.
Maya K: Putting :eyes: on the candidate packet now. If I'm lead, I'll collect notes and run debrief at end.
Sam: Awesome. Action items: Maya = lead + system-design; Jordan = infra (shortened); Alia = product + host pre-read; Sam = debrief template + send anchors; Nate = confirm candidate & calendar. PeopleOps Bot = reminder for debriefs. Thanks all :rocket:
PeopleOps Bot: Reaction recorded — :white_check_mark: (thread pinned to #people-ops for visibility).
